parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key (1 to 128 printable ASCII characters), one per logical submit. A repeat of the same request (method, path, body) with the same key within 24 hours returns the first response (status and body, header Idempotency-Replayed: true); a refusal (4xx) is replayed too, a server failure (5xx) is not stored. The same key with another request is 409 idempotency-key-reused.
